understanding.goal_understanding: Reach the goal gem tile marked '+' in each level while avoiding spikes, continuing until the game is won.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Movement uses directional actions, with gravity currently pulling the player downward and causing position changes along connected paths. Clicking tiles removes clickable tiles but does not move the player. Landing on a spike ends the current attempt; each level allows two attempts with up to 50 turns. Undo can reverse a recent action when available.
